scope: CPU dtype and installed-source inspection only; not GPU control implementation or causal proof
rank_change_hypothesis: Changing A output channels and B reduction dimension can choose different GEMM accumulation/kernel path. Adapter FP32 deltas are added then cast back to BF16 base result at each layer; small pre-cast differences may cross BF16 rounding thresholds and propagate. TF32 off/determinism do not require cross-shape bitwise equality.
alternative_hypothesis: Historical-source and freshly loaded expanded comparisons confound process/global runtime state; fresh source baseline first is necessary before attributing all deviation to rank.
root_next_control: Gradient owns fresh source-vs-expanded control. Include source-vs-historical first, duplicate source repeat if unstable; record actual adapter/base/output dtypes and precision flags. If source repeat stable but crossrank fails, minimal first divergent LoRA-layer pre/post-cast diagnostic in sameprocess before any training.
standard_remedy_boundary: If confirmed rank-shaped roundoff, standard FP32 model+adapter sameinput inference/FP32 safe-merge reference is allowed numerical reference with new hashes/receipt, not BF16 preservation proof; keep tolerance, do not zero all new A/B, change output logits or add custom rank-sliced engine wrapper.
